title: Whole Life Insurance Nonforfeiture Table: Grace Period, Automatic Premium Loan and Default Options
content:
On every tier of Whole Life Insurance the grace period after an unpaid installment, the availability of the automatic premium loan, the nonforfeiture option applied when the owner has made no election, the election period and the smallest reduced paid-up face are fixed by tier as follows.

## Grace period

| Tier | Grace period (calendar days from the unpaid installment's due date) | Issue-state replacement |
|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Final Expense Whole Life | 31 | CA: 60 days |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100 | 31 | CA: 60 days |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 65 | 31 | CA: 60 days |
| Ashgrove 20-Pay Whole Life | 31 | CA: 60 days |
| Ashgrove 10-Pay Whole Life | 31 | CA: 60 days |
| Ashgrove Single Premium Whole Life | 31 | CA: 60 days |

A policy whose issue state is California (CA) has a grace period of 60 calendar days in place of 31; every other issue state uses 31.

## Automatic premium loan and nonforfeiture options

| Tier | Automatic premium loan may be elected | Option applied when the owner has not elected otherwise | Extended term available when the underwriting class is table rated or a tobacco class |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Final Expense Whole Life | No | Reduced paid-up | No |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100 | Yes | Extended term | No |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 65 | Yes | Extended term | No |
| Ashgrove 20-Pay Whole Life | Yes | Extended term | No |
| Ashgrove 10-Pay Whole Life | Yes | Extended term | No |
| Ashgrove Single Premium Whole Life | No | Extended term | No |

## Election period and smallest reduced paid-up face (all tiers)

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Period after the unpaid installment's due date within which the owner may elect a different nonforfeiture option or cash surrender | 60 calendar days |
| Smallest reduced paid-up face; when the net cash value buys less, it is paid in cash instead | 1000 USD |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical policies)

- A Paid-Up at 100 policy issued in Ohio with an installment due on March 3 has a grace period of 31 days; the same policy issued in California has 60 days.
- On a 20-Pay policy whose owner made no election, extended term is the option applied by default; on a Final Expense policy it is reduced paid-up.
- On any tier, where the underwriting class is table rated or a tobacco class, extended term is not available.
- A net cash value that would buy a reduced paid-up face of 1000 dollars meets the smallest face; one that would buy 999 dollars does not.
